about: Questions over the sample lab (scripts/make_sample_lab.py plus the two protocol pages scripts/eval-ask.sh adds), each with the sources a right answer cites. A file is named by the end of its path; 'protocol:<title start>' is a protocol page. Any one of them counts. 'expect': null means the lab's records don't answer it, so the right outcome is no answer.
